nodes.name: Run Manually
nodes.notes: MANUAL console to look at a backup, same as SQL Console and YCloud Console. No schedule. It cannot send a WhatsApp message or touch the database: it only READS a file from B2. Decided on 2026-09-10, design B-I.

nodes.name: Pick Date
nodes.notes: The only place to edit: the DATE constant.

nodes.name: Download From B2
nodes.notes: READ ONLY. The file shows up in this node's output with a download button. Through the API it downloads decrypted; the B2 web panel will not let you download it because it has SSE-B2 (design B-H). This execution is NOT saved (saveManualExecutions false): it is visible while open and leaves no copy of the table in the n8n database.
